fields.PRODUCT NAME: Rajasthani Hand-Painted Patchwork Wooden Tray Set (Set of 3)
fields.DESCRIPTION: Add a splash of colour and tradition to your home with this beautiful hand-painted wooden tray set of three, inspired by the vibrant patchwork art of Rajasthan. Each tray is adorned with bright hues and intricate motifs such as paisleys, florals, and geometric patterns, all painted by skilled artisans.
